stem: Which details from paragraphs 5 through 7 best support the key idea that the benefits of participatory budgeting are long-lasting?

options.text: Those taking part in a participatory budgeting program in Arizona used the internet to gather possible project ideas.
Students who are involved in participatory budgeting programs learn money-management and budgeting skills.
Engaging in participatory budgeting programs increases the chances that a person will vote in elections.
Most of the students in one New York participatory budgeting program voted to fund a greenhouse garden.
One student in a participatory budgeting program said that the process made her feel as though her voice had been heard.
